title: D Block
desc: When the female students of an engineering college mysteriously disappear and are found dead, a young man and his friends decide to look for the culprit.

title: Lift
desc: A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

desc: Surya, a young man with anger issues, channels his emotions on Saturdays, because of a promise to his deceased mother. However, things get complicated when he decides to confront a corrupt cop.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Ayyanar
desc: Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. However, when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.

desc: After being harmed by the corrupt system, Subhash organises a group of young allies, and together they embark on a mission to fight the various vices in society.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Mynaa
desc: To avoid getting into an unwanted marriage, Mynaa escapes with her childhood love, Suruli, and plans to marry him. Along the way, they face many problems and fate has something drastic in store.

title: Vasuvum Saravananum Onna Padichavanga
desc: Vasu and Saravanan have been best friends since childhood. However, they become upset when their girlfriends do not approve of their friendship.
